title: Food Balance
description: Everyone deserve their own favorite foods.
body:
🍽️ Food Balance

"Make every bite count."



--- ## Overview Spice up your survival experience with **Food Balance** – a *vanilla-friendly datapack* that redefines how food works, perfect for players who want **fresh mechanics** without drifting from the core Minecraft feel. 🔗 **Synergy:** Compatible with **[Apple Enchant](https://modrinth.com/datapack/apple-enchant)** and **[Mooshroom Energy](https://modrinth.com/datapack/energy)** for expanded food mechanics! --- ## Features ### Vanilla-Friendly - Seamless integration into your world. - No major gameplay changes. - Only needs a **server-side install** for multiplayer! ### Unique Food Effects - Every food has a purpose. - No two items share the same effect. - All foods are balanced — **no absolute best food**. ### Buffed Forgotten Foods - Useless items are no more! - Formerly ignored foods now have **meaningful, fun mechanics**. --- ## Examples - **Farming meals** grant **extra hearts** for half a Minecraft day. - **Spider eyes** offer **Night Vision** and **Weaving**. - **Rotten flesh** turns you **half-undead** — spooky! - **Honey bottles** become your best friend in the mines. - And finally... **Rabbit Stew** is worth crafting (and it’s HUGE)! --- ## 📜 License **All Rights Reserved** ✅ **You are free to:** - Add this datapack to your modpacks (provided you use the **Modrinth download link**). - Share the official Modrinth page with others. - Modify the code strictly for **personal use**. ❌ **Without explicit permission, you CANNOT:** - Reupload this datapack or its files anywhere else. - Use the code, assets, or mechanics in other public projects.
